clarification: The producer reports a CANDIDATE construction replacing higher-body interactions of an existing3D passive-memory proposal with local THREE-BODY QUBIT interactions while retaining long-lived thermal storage under a specified noise model. Two internal reviews checked DIFFERENT PARTS and caught corrections still being incorporated;the full proof remains conditional. The later stricter resource check reports an extraordinarily small CURRENT SUFFICIENT temperature scale and no earned efficient loading of a qubit into the required thermal state. That small scale is a conservative proof guarantee,not a demonstrated physical lower limit. Candidate status and corrections being incorporated remain. Reviews of parts do not establish the full proof. The source noise model is specified by the producer but not supplied here;no general hardware-error tolerance is inferred. Conservative sufficient temperature is not a physical impossibility threshold. The earlier N1638 graph-local high-body autonomous noisy-witness/reset construction retains its native few-body,3D,reset and noisy-input/output obligations;these reports do not close them. No lifetime exponent,Hamiltonian,preparation operation,proof unit or benchmark is invented from these brief reports.
